title: THE PULSE CORE
logline: A boy reaches for something older than the mountain, and the mountain answers. Episode 01 ends on the first contact.
grade: Total palette collapse to blue + skin. Everything that is not a face becomes a blue value. Final 4 frames: pure white → hard cut to black → title.

narration.hi: उस पल मुझे समझ नहीं आ रहा था कि मेरे साथ क्या हो रहा है।
narration.en: In that moment I couldn't understand what was happening to me.

narration.hi: मैं बस एक चीज़ जानता था...
अब कुछ भी पहले जैसा नहीं रहने वाला था।
narration.en: Nothing was ever going to be the same again.

shots.cam: Interior, height 1.30 m at the chamber mouth, subject 60 m away
shots.move: Static. Fade up from black over 2 s, already inside the reveal. No whoosh, no shake.
shots.action: The chamber: a domed void, 60 m across, ribbed stone pillars converging overhead, and at its centre — floating a metre above a circular dais — the CORE.
shots.env: L12 chamber: concentric floor rings, a 40 m apical oculus (sealed), water on the floor reflecting everything, the sigil pattern inlaid in a 30 m radius.
shots.light: The Core is the only light. Blue at 100%, with physically plausible falloff — pillars near it are bright, the mouth of the chamber is almost black.
shots.vfx: VFX HERO SHOT 3: volumetric shafts through the haze; reflection in standing water; slow orbital particles. The Core must read as ANCIENT, INTELLIGENT, MYSTERIOUS — not a crystal.
shots.vo: Silence for the first 4 s of the reveal. Let the room be the loudest thing in the film.
shots.cont: The dome's rib count and pillar positions are locked to a plan drawing (see Environment Bible, A-12). S13-06 must match this geometry exactly.

shots.cam: Interior, height 1.55 m, wide on the two boys at the chamber mouth
shots.move: Slight 8° push, then stop. They do not move for 12 s.
shots.action: Kabir takes one step in, then stops and grabs Ishaan's sleeve. Ishaan keeps walking. Kabir lets go.
shots.expr: Kabir: fear, correctly. Ishaan: compulsion, incorrectly.
shots.env: The mouth of the chamber, the vast space beyond.
shots.light: They are rim-lit from 60 m away — small blue silhouettes with warm skin edges.
shots.cont: THE DECISION POINT: Kabir does NOT follow past the third ring. He stays at the mouth. But he must be visible in S13-06 — do not lose him.

shots.cam: Interior, height 1.45 m, tracking sideways with him as he crosses the floor
shots.move: Smooth lateral track, 0.7 m/s, perfect steadiness — the camera is being pulled too.
shots.action: He walks across the water-film floor. Ripples spread from each footfall. As he advances, geometric lines in the floor ignite one ring at a time, ahead of him, as if leading.
shots.expr: Not scared. That is the unsettling part.
shots.env: Floor rings, water film, inlaid sigil widening.
shots.light: Blue key from the Core, climbing his body as he approaches; his jacket's red lining goes black-and-blue.
shots.vfx: Ripple simulation + ring ignition with a 0.4 s propagation, plus a reflection double in the water that is very slightly out of sync.
shots.vo: Silence. Only the wet footfalls that we never hear.
shots.cont: The ring he is standing on must be identical in count to S13-06. Count them: 9 concentric rings.

shots.cam: Interior, height 1.50 m, 3/4 front on Ishaan, the Core's light behind and above him
shots.action: He stops a metre away. He raises his right hand — his thumb brushes the small blue accent on his sleeve once, the first habit from S04-04 — and then he extends his fingers.
shots.expr: Wonder. Mouth open, eyes wide, no fear at all. The audience should want to shout at him.
shots.env: Core glow behind him, out of focus.
shots.light: Full blue key from above-front, warm fill retained in the skin so he doesn't look like a corpse.
shots.vfx: Particles drawn toward his hand, 2 frames behind his motion.
shots.vo: Line 1 continues and lands at 34:22, on the raised hand.
shots.cont: RIGHT hand, always. Do not mirror the shot — the sleeve accent is only on the RIGHT arm; if you mirror, the continuity is destroyed.

shots.cam: Interior, level with his fingertips, 8 cm away
shots.move: Static. The last 3 s are completely still before contact.
shots.action: Fingertips stop 2 cm from the surface. The air between skin and Core distorts. Contact.
shots.env: The Core's surface: not glass, not crystal — a suspended laminar fluid that holds an internal lattice of light. Ancient, layered, almost organic.
shots.light: At contact the key jumps 2 stops — but only on the fingers, never on the whole frame.
shots.vfx: VFX HERO SHOT 4: a shockwave that is a SILENCE of light — the glow collapses inward for 6 frames, then blooms outward in the sigil's geometry. No sparks. No electricity. No lightning.
shots.vo: Silence. Absolute. This is the episode's loudest moment and it has no sound at all.
shots.cont: The Core's internal lattice must resolve into the S12-02 sigil when viewed at contact. Continuity supervisor: compare frames at 100%.

shots.cam: Interior, height 1.20 m — the SAME framing and height as S02-07, but from behind Ishaan
shots.move: Static. The light floods from the centre outward in 2 s.
shots.action: Blue energy travels out along every groove, ring, pillar and sigil in the chamber. The water brightens. Ishaan is a silhouette at the centre of a mandala of light. Kabir covers his eyes at the mouth.
shots.expr: Ishaan's face is only a profile edge — the rest is absorbed by the light.
shots.env: The whole chamber, now fully lit by its own patterns.
shots.light: Rim + silhouette. The light arrives in waves, not all at once — three pulses, rising.
shots.vfx: Full-chamber propagation, reflection, volumetric bloom, particle storm held to a readable density. Controlled, architectural, magnificent.
shots.vo: Line 2 at 34:30 — 'I only knew one thing' — delivered over the flood, quietly.
shots.cont: MOTIF-01 PAYOFF: this is the mirror of S02-07 (watching his family from a doorway). Same height, same lens, same framing language — but inverted: he is now the thing being watched.

shots.cam: Interior, eye-line, filling the frame with one eye
shots.move: Static. Iris dilation on a 6-frame curve. Cut to white for 4 frames, then hard cut to black.
shots.action: One eye, flooded with blue. The amber flecks in the iris brighten — the only warm thing left. Then a single line of light crosses the pupil, like a scan.
shots.env: Skin texture, eyelashes, one tear forming but not falling.
shots.light: Blue everywhere except the amber iris flecks, which must stay amber.
shots.vfx: Iris detail, subtle chromatic shift at the edges only, one scan line. NO full-frame distortion.
shots.cont: The tear does not fall in Episode 01. Do not resolve it. It belongs to Episode 02.
shots.tail: 34:58–35:02 black. 35:02 TITLE CARD: PULSEBOUND — EPISODE 01. 35:08: TO BE CONTINUED.
